symbols.name: NguDropdownField
symbols.summary:
Renderer of `type: 'dropdown'`: an `<ngu-dropdown>` with server paging, search and virtual
scrolling. ngu-form keeps the label, hint and messages; the dropdown shows the error state
when ngu-form shows the error. A list value makes it a multiple select.

members.name: field
members.description: The field to edit, bound to the dropdown with `[formField]`. Set by ngu-form.

members.name: def
members.description: The field's spec, with the dropdown options. Set by ngu-form.

members.name: id
members.description: Id of the dropdown's trigger, used by the label's `for`. Set by ngu-form.

members.name: invalid
members.description: True while ngu-form shows the field's error; the dropdown then shows its error state.

members.name: describedBy
members.description: Ids of the field's hint and messages, for `aria-describedby`. Set by ngu-form.

members.name: choices
members.description: Options resolved by ngu-form: lists, signals and functions of the model.

symbols.name: NguDropdownFieldOptions

members.name: options
members.description:
A static list of rows, a signal of rows, or a function of the model for cascading lists.
Rows are objects (read with `optionValue` and `optionLabel`) or plain strings.

members.name: fetch
members.description: Loads one page of rows from the server: `(query, { signal }) => Observable | Promise`.

members.name: lookup
members.description: Loads the rows of values that are not on a loaded page yet, such as a saved record's.

members.name: optionValue
members.description: Path of the value in a row. Default `'value'`, or `provideNguDropdownConfig`.

members.name: optionLabel
members.description: Path of the label, or a function of the row. Default `'label'`.

members.name: filters
members.description: Sent to `fetch` with every query; a signal re-queries when it changes.

members.name: search
members.description: Show the search box. Default: with a `fetch`, or more than 8 options (ngu-dropdown's `searchThreshold`).

members.name: maxChips
members.description: Chips shown before "+3 more" in multiple mode. Default 2.

symbols.name: NguDropdownValue
symbols.summary: What a dropdown stores: the chosen row's key, or the keys of a multiple selection.
symbols.signature: export type NguDropdownValue = string | number | null | readonly (string | number)[];

symbols.name: provideNguDropdown
symbols.summary:
Registers `type: 'dropdown'`. Add it next to your other providers; importing
`ngu-form/dropdown` also teaches TypeScript the type and its options.

```ts
providers: [provideNguDropdown(), provideNguDropdownConfig({ optionValue: 'id', optionLabel: 'name' })]
```
